review.notes: Accurate T CI43522417893 failed the unchanged replaced-identical assertion on Linux. The log did not record both inode values; do not invent observed values or label this infrastructure. The dev/inode+body predicate cannot distinguish a quickly reused identifier from the original file. Add captured fstat ctime (seconds/nanoseconds) to durable claim evidence and reject metadata changes during the bounded read. Preserve every T test byte and assertion. A deterministic same-inode/same-content/same-mtime but observed-ctime-changed fixture exercises the missing distinction without allocator probability or sleep. Under the existing cooperating-writer lease, only a recognized interrupted publication may change ctime legitimately: refused queue link may carry a newer payload; uncertain parked link must still have exact original payload and inode. All other conflicts remain held. This is observed file evidence, not an atomic filesystem CAS against an adversarial same-user path writer. No real queues, claims, input, configuration or services.
